in_sanskrit.name: Narshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Narasimha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Narshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Narasimha is a form of Vishnu, the preserver in Hinduism. The name Narshi comes from Narasimha, meaning 'man-lion'. Narasimha is depicted as a man with the head of a lion, symbolizing his fierce yet protective nature.
